Comment: Looks up a region's risk score and branches based on its risk tier. This is a deliberately small example of the orchestration pattern used elsewhere in this project's design - see docs/architecture.md for how pipeline.py's stages would map to a larger state machine.

GetRegionRisk.Comment: Invokes the region-risk-lookup Lambda. In the console's visual editor you can pick the function from a dropdown instead of pasting an ARN here.

FlagForReview.Comment: In a real deployment this would publish to an SNS topic or write to a review queue instead of just passing through.
